title: NDT ABRET Registry Exam Prep
description: Comprehensive review of Neurodiagnostic Technology concepts in preparation for the ABRET National Registry Board Exam (R.EEG T.) PREREQUISITE: NDT A115. Transfer Credit: CSU.
outcomes: Demonstrate knowledge and application of EEG concepts in the Neurodiagnostic field of practice.
objectives: Demonstrate application of EEG concepts by successfully completing a simulated registry examination of at least 200 questions.
Demonstrate comprehension of EEG activities through evaluation/interpretation of EEG tracings and report findings in the neonate, pediatric and adult patients.
Discriminate common EEG artifacts and implement troubleshooting techniques to eliminate or monitor event.
Adhere to appropriate standards for the Neurodiagnostic field related to ethics and practice.
assignments: (1.5 hours/week) Read assigned texts, journal articles, and ACNS guidelines.
Written Technical impressions from Discussion board assignments of EEG tracings.
(1.5 hours/week) Practice quizzes and Discussion board assignments. (12 week course)
